summary: The proposed patch addresses a regression issue with QuerySet.only() after select_related() on proxy models, but introduces a potential maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The patch introduces a magic string 'concrete_model' which may not be immediately clear to readers unfamiliar with the Django codebase.
The automated tests already pass, but it would be beneficial to add additional tests to ensure the fix is robust and doesn't introduce any new regressions.
